2.293.27
Style.PaddingRight
The Style.PaddingRight element specifies the padding between the right edge of a report item and
its contents. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize or an
expression that evaluates to an RdlSize.
The value of the Style.PaddingRight element MUST NOT be a size that is greater than 1000 pt or the
equivalent. If the grandparent element of this element is not Textbox, Subtotal, or Image, the
Style.PaddingRight element is ignored.
Following is the parent element of the Style.PaddingRight element.
Parent elements
Style
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Style.PaddingRight element.
 <xsd:element name="PaddingRight" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
